[js.warn] [grassPopulation] grass instance cap 1048576 hit — field truncated; raise MAX_INSTANCES
resolution: Investigated why the grass cap still hit (and the editor still OOM'd) after defaulting showFlora=false: grass builds ONLY through GrassField → GameWorld3D's {showFlora ? ...} block, so showFlora was arriving TRUE — the iso pane's floraVisible twig (useRouteTwigState ISO_ROUTE) persisted true and overrode my default. Rather than chase twig persistence, fixed it at the rendering boundary in GrassField.tsx (FoliageField): cap the shipped instance buffer to EDITOR_FOLIAGE_RENDER_CAP=65536 blades (slice copy so the full 1M-row buffer never reaches the command stream). This guarantees no million-row Scene3D.Instances command regardless of the toggle/twig state, so the editor opens. Same change as req_1645. Awaiting the user's restart to confirm the OOM is gone.
